summary: Verdict: pass. All six round 1 findings are fixed, and no Blocker or Major remains. The regex matches both real Lending forms, and it matched no work task among 2671 plan tasks. A prototype built from the spec text reproduces every claimed fixture output, and all 148 existing Python tests still pass with it. The Red cases catch each wrong version that I built, except one contrived version that lets a closed review task use the ignore. Three new Nits remain: the regex misses letter-suffix ids, no task owns the CHANGELOG entry, and FR-4 dropped the closeout clause.
nonblocking_findings: F7 [Nit] spec.md FR-1: The number part of the regex, `\d+(?:\.\d+)*`, accepts no letter, so `- [~] 4b.5 Review A.` and `- [~] 4.13s Adversarial tests` still fail the jr-green gate. Rationale: The regex matches 13 of 15 distinct role tasks in the Measure and Lending plans. It misses `4b.5` (daily_model_schedule) and `4.13s` (model_guide). The miss is safe, because the gate fails as today. Allow one letter after each number. Add one Red case.

F8 [Nit] plan.md Task 1.2: FR-4 adds one `CHANGELOG.md` entry, but no task owns it. Task 1.2 cites FR-1 through FR-3, and Task 1.3 holds only the pull request and the records. Add the entry to Task 1.2. Rationale: The four earlier checker commits (f68a87f, 94698fe, 7e6dc79, 27c2ed0) each added the entry with the checker change. The Green role file names implementation files, Green tests, and plan updates, not `CHANGELOG.md`. A task without an owner can leave FR-4 open until phase acceptance.

F9 [Nit] spec.md FR-4: FR-4 says `exactly`, but the closeout step of the light lane changes more files. Name them again: `measure/tracks.md`, `measure/archive/<track>/`, and `measure/runs/<track>/`. Rationale: The earlier text of FR-4 named the closeout files, and the revision removed that sentence. The closeout of audit_role_gate_allow_20261123 (commit 800df77) changed all three paths. An auditor can read `exactly` as a scope breach.
evidence: HEAD c5bc2ff7afcf28172c4421f0cbf630036035be3a equals audited_head_sha. The working tree was clean at the start and at the end. The branch is fix/green-gate-open-review-task.

Role rule note: one combined shell command printed measure/tracks/green_gate_review_task_20261124/spec-review.md by mistake. The file held only the Author model line and an empty `## Spec Review` heading. It gave this review no input.

F1 fixed. The FR-1 regex matches `Task 3.5 Review A ...` and `3.5 Review A.`. It matched no work task in 2671 task lines of 196 plans: 24 matches, all role tasks. The round 1 counter-examples (`per the acceptance criteria`, `Review assignments`) now fail the match.

F2 fixed. Plan Task 1.1 now holds the deferred cases, the unfinished Green case, and the SHA case. Against wrong versions, the deferred cases catch a helper with no deferred check, and the SHA case catches a helper that skips the SHA check.

F3 fixed. Each case names a fixture and an output. A prototype built from the spec text gave every claimed output through the real role-gate command, in one temporary git repository per case. The mid-red and review-a fixtures catch a change of phase_counts.

F4 fixed: FR-1 says `at most one`. F5 fixed: FR-3 keeps the five-value return, names the three callers, and names phase_blocks and the task-line pattern. F6 fixed: FR-4 adds CHANGELOG.md and the post-merge install, and Out of Scope adds no tech-debt row.

FR-3 line numbers hold at HEAD: phase_blocks at line 371, callers at lines 1293, 1334, and 1359, and the task-line pattern at lines 386, 400, and 415. No other caller of phase_counts exists in the repository.

Installer claim holds: bin/install-targets.tsv maps skills/measure-orchestrator to ~/.agents/skills/measure-orchestrator, and the installer reads the ref (default main), so the install must follow the merge. The installed checker equals the repo copy today.

Lending fixture holds: commit 6faaf42 of lending-desk-bench, measure/tracks/domain_trust/plan.md lines 140 to 199, has the Phase 3 heading, tasks 3.1 to 3.4 as [x] with SHAs, `- [~] 3.5 Review A.`, and two [b] tasks. The checker reads no [b] line. The current checker fails it (incomplete 1). The prototype passes it.

Claimed outputs, current checker versus prototype: base plus one [~] Review A gives FAIL before and PASS after. Two label tasks give `still has 2` before and `still has 1` after. The eleven label forms and the Lending fixture pass only after. The boundary cases give the same result before and after.

Mid-red and review-a: for the plan fixtures, the current checker and the prototype both give `PASS: mid-red gate passed` and `FAIL: current phase still has 1 non-deferred incomplete tasks`. A version that changes phase_counts fails both cases. The mid-red fixture needs its open [ ] task to catch that version.
Mutation check with 13 wrong versions: the plan cases catch 12. The survivor lets a closed [x] review task use the ignore. No natural implementation does this, so it is not a finding.

Existing tests: no fixture in tests/ holds a [~] task that starts with a role label. All 148 Python tests of tests/spec_review_gate pass with the prototype, in a throwaway copy of the repository, run through heavy-run.sh at priority p1.

Regex coverage over the Measure and four Lending plan sets: 15 distinct role tasks, 13 match, 2 miss (`4b.5` and `4.13s`, F7). Zero work tasks match. The Measure form `Run measure-review-a-correctness` is not a label at the start, so the rule leaves it open. This is safe and in scope.

FR-4 precedent: the four earlier checker commits each changed CHANGELOG.md with the checker. The closeout of audit_role_gate_allow_20261123 (commit 800df77) changed measure/tracks.md, measure/archive, and measure/runs (F8, F9). No live document states the jr-green task rule, so no document goes stale.
Plan Task 1.3 stays open at the Green gate, as in audit_role_gate_allow_20261123. A records round closes it. This is a process note, not a finding.

Method note: the experiments ran as Python from stdin, with temporary folders that the program removed. The edit rule of this role denied a script file in /tmp. The shell rule `*rm *` denied two runs because a variable name ended in `rm`. This is the known unanchored-glob issue.

paraphrase.proposes: This chore makes the jr-green role gate ignore at most one open `[~]` task whose title starts with a later-role label. A case-insensitive regex pins the labels `Review A`, `Review B`, `Review C`, `Adversarial`, and `Acceptance`, and a word in the body never matches. A helper used only by the jr-green branch holds the logic, and `phase_counts` keeps its five-value return. A `[ ]` task, a `deferred` task, a second label task, and the SHA-evidence check stay as today. Red adds a contract test with named fixtures, Green adds the helper, and the change set holds one `CHANGELOG.md` entry.
paraphrase.current_system: `phase_counts` in `skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py` reads one phase of `plan.md` and returns five counts. A task counts as incomplete when it is not `[x]` and its text has no `deferred`. The jr-green branch fails with `current phase still has N non-deferred incomplete tasks` when the incomplete count is above zero. Mid-red, jr-green, and the review and phase-acceptance branch each unpack the five values, and final-acceptance uses `track_incomplete`. Lending rule A12 marks the review task `[~]` before Review A starts, so the open task 3.5 fails the jr-green gate.
